name: io.github.pantoniades/sakila-mcp
title: Sakila MCP
description: Read-only MySQL MCP server with a fail-closed SQL classifier and structured results.

environmentVariables.name: SAKILA_MCP_USER
environmentVariables.description: MySQL account name. Give it read-only grants.

environmentVariables.name: SAKILA_MCP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of the MySQL account. Empty if the account has none.

environmentVariables.name: SAKILA_MCP_DATABASE_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated databases the agent may query. Empty means every non-system database.
